snippet.title: Можно ли взрывом отправить снаряд в космос?
snippet.description:
Если взрывчатка сработает внутри снаряда, его просто разорвёт. Можно ли просверлить дырку и улететь в космос? Шаг за шагом — как из снаряда получается твердотопливная ракета.

🚀 Взрывчатка не горит, а детонирует: у тротила фронт идёт ≈ 6900 м/с, весь заряд срабатывает за сотые доли миллисекунды — газ не успевает выйти ни в какую дырку. 🚀 Порох горит, а не детонирует: если он горит с торца, площадь горения маленькая — тяги не хватает. 🚀 Канал по центру: горит вся стенка канала, и чем шире канал, тем больше площадь — тяга растёт. 🚀 Канал-звезда даёт самую большую тягу на старте, когда ракета тяжелее всего; лучи выгорают — площадь и тяга падают. Звёздный канал был, например, в переднем сегменте ускорителей шаттла. 🚀 Сопло Лаваля: сужение и раструб разгоняют газ до сверхзвука и направляют его вдоль оси. 🚀 Твердотопливные метеоракеты поднимаются выше 100 км — линии Кармана, условной границы космоса.

Источники: Table of explosive detonation velocities, De Laval nozzle, Space Shuttle Solid Rocket Booster, Black Brant (en.wikipedia.org); NASA Glenn — Nozzle Design; MIT Rocket Team — Solid motor grain geometry; Georgia Tech AE4451 — Solid propellant motors.

3D-сцены собраны в Blender кодом. Небо, грунт, бетон — Poly Haven (CC0). Snow Rig (CC) Blender Foundation | studio.blender.org. Текстуры Земли: Solar System Scope (solarsystemscope.com), CC BY 4.0. Голос, музыка и звуки — ElevenLabs.

About CID:
----------
The first thrilling investigative series on Indian Television is also one of the most popular shows on Sony Entertainment Television. Dramatic and absolutely unpredictable, "C.I.D." has captivated viewers over the last twenty years and continues to keep audiences glued to their television sets with its thrilling plots and excitement. Also interwoven in its fast-paced plots are the personal challenges that the C.I.D. team faces with non-stop adventure, tremendous pressure and risk, all in the name of duty. The series consists of hard-core police procedural stories dealing with investigation, detection and suspense. The protagonists of the serial are an elite group of officers belonging to the Crime Investigation Department, led by ACP Pradyuman (played by the dynamic Shivaji Satam). While the stories are plausible, there is an emphasis on dramatic plotting and technical complexities faced by the police. At every stage, the plot throws up intriguing twists and turns keeping the officers on the move as they track criminals, led by the smallest of clues.

भारतीय टेलीविजन पर पहली रोमांचक जांच श्रृंखला सोनी एंटरटेनमेंट टेलीविजन पर सबसे लोकप्रिय शो में से एक है। नाटकीय और बिल्कुल अप्रत्याशित, "सी.आई.डी." ने पिछले बीस वर्षों से दर्शकों को आकर्षित किया है और अपने रोमांचक कथानक और उत्साह के साथ दर्शकों को अपने टेलीविजन सेट से बांधे रखता है। इसके तेज़-तर्रार कथानक में व्यक्तिगत चुनौतियाँ भी शामिल हैं, जिनका सामना सी.आई.डी. टीम को बिना रुके रोमांच, जबरदस्त दबाव और जोखिम के साथ करना पड़ता है, यह सब कर्तव्य के नाम पर होता है। इस श्रृंखला में जांच, पता लगाने और रहस्य से जुड़ी हार्ड-कोर पुलिस प्रक्रियात्मक कहानियाँ शामिल हैं। धारावाहिक के नायक अपराध जांच विभाग से संबंधित अधिकारियों का एक कुलीन समूह है, जिसका नेतृत्व एसीपी प्रद्युमन (गतिशील शिवाजी साटम द्वारा निभाया गया) करता है। जबकि कहानियाँ विश्वसनीय हैं, नाटकीय कथानक और पुलिस द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली तकनीकी जटिलताओं पर ज़ोर दिया गया है। हर चरण में, कथानक में ऐसे दिलचस्प मोड़ आते हैं जो अधिकारियों को अपराधियों का पता लगाने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं, जो सबसे छोटे सुरागों के आधार पर होते हैं

snippet.title: The Midnight Boat Kitchen That Opens Only in a Lighthouse Blackout #shorts
snippet.description:
At 2:20 AM in the dense midnight sea fog of the 1990s Pamban–Mandapam Sea Channel, the lighthouse beam cuts out for maintenance—leaving the dark waters blind. Guided only by the glowing red embers of an anchored teakwood boat stove, local fishermen find a secret floating kitchen serving fiery kanava (squid) pepper roast, crispy golden nethili fry, and steaming coconut puttu on fresh green banana leaves.

When a shivering young boy rowing a leaking wooden dinghy drifts out of the mist with only three damp coins in his pocket, the boatmen remind him of an unspoken rule of the sea: the children of the ocean never pay for a warm meal.

Experience 1990s Ramanathapuram coastal Tamil storytelling, authentic ASMR cooking sounds over black waves, and nostalgic 2D hand-painted anime art by John Ghibli.

snippet.title: CV'ye Bir Kovulma Daha Eklendi - Tuzlu Kahve
snippet.description:
Ünver, Aybüke'yi işten kovdu. AYBÜKE KO-VUL-DUN!
Tuzlu Kahve 12. Bölüm Sahnelerini İzlemek İçin: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKBpEyMl_1eA

Poll Films imzalı Tuzlu Kahve dizisi her Salı 20.00'de Star'da!

Bölüm Özeti;
Murat ve Aybüke arasında yaşananların ortaya çıkmasıyla iki aile arasındaki dengeler altüst olur. Murat kendini affettirmeye çalışırken, Kutaygil Ailesi’nin başına gelen felaket herkesi aynı çatı altında buluşturur. Aileler arasındaki çekişmeler sürerken, sürpriz bir vasiyet işleri iyice karıştırır. Tüm bu karmaşanın ortasında Derin ve Mehmet, herkesten gizli nikah masasına oturmaya karar verir. Peki, Hatun ve Tiraje bu evliliğe engel olabilecek midir?

Dizi Özeti;
İstanbul’un köklü ve varlıklı ailelerinden birinin torunu olan Derin, hayatını belirli bir plana göre yaşamaya çalışan, evlenip yuva kurmayı en büyük hedefi haline getirmiş genç bir kadındır. Ancak uzun süredir devam eden ilişkisine rağmen bir türlü gerçekleşmeyen düğün hazırlıkları ve ailesinin bitmek bilmeyen beklentileri, onu her geçen gün daha fazla baskı altına almaktadır. Diğer tarafta ise yıllardır yurt dışında yaşayan Mehmet, ailevi sebeplerle Türkiye’ye döner. Başarılı, kendi ayakları üzerinde duran ve hayatını alıştığı düzende sürdürmek isteyen Mehmet’in dönüşü, ailesi için yeni umutların başlangıcı olur. Özellikle annesi, oğlunun artık ülkesine, ailesine ve kuracağı yeni hayata bağlanmasını istemektedir. Bunun için oğluna bir gelin adayı bile bulmuştur. Tam bu dönemde Mehmet’in kardeşi Murat’ın evlilik hazırlıkları, Derin’in hayatında hiç beklemediği kapıları aralar. Murat’ın nişanlısı ve ailesiyle, Derin arasında geçmişe dayanan gerilimler, iki ailenin yollarını kesiştirirken, yıllardır gizli kalmış duyguların ve hesapların da yeniden gündeme gelmesine neden olur. Bambaşka dünyalara ait gibi görünen Mehmet ve Derin’in yolları, ailelerin beklentileri, geçmişten gelen yükler, sırlar, yanlış anlaşılmalar ve sürpriz karşılaşmalar eşliğinde kesişmeye başlar.

Tuzlu Kahve, aşkın sadece iki insan arasında değil, aileler, gelenekler ve hayatın dayattığı beklentiler arasında da sınandığı; romantik komedi ile aile dramasını iç içe geçiren sıcak, eğlenceli ve duygusal bir hikâye anlatmaktadır.

snippet.title: 😲Udupi style Uppitu🤯15 mins breakfast ready 🔥#foodiesroof
snippet.description:
Udupi Style upittu ❤️

Upma lovers, you have to try this! ❤️

This Udupi-style uppitu is quite similar to our regular upma, but a few little differences make a big difference to the taste. The addition of fresh coconut gives it a lovely, mild flavour and a slightly different texture that makes it so comforting and delicious.

If you love upma, I'm sure you'll enjoy this too!

Share this with your upma-loving friends and tell me in the comments: Are you an UPMA LOVER or an UPMA HATER? 😂

Recipe:

1. In a pan, add 1 tsp ghee, 1 tsp chana dal and 1 tsp urad dal. Add 1 cup upma rava (sooji rava) and roast everything lightly. Keep aside.
2. In the same pan, heat 1 tbsp ghee or oil. Add ½ tsp mustard seeds and ½ tsp cumin seeds.
3. Once they splutter, add curry leaves, 3 slit green chillies, cashews and 1 tsp grated ginger.
4. Add 1 large finely chopped onion and sauté until it turns soft. You can also add vegetables of your choice.
5. Pour in 3 cups of water. Add 1 tsp salt, a handful of chopped coriander leaves and ½ cup freshly grated coconut.
6. Let the water come to a good boil. Unlike our regular Tamil Nadu-style upma, Udupi-style puttu uses freshly grated coconut, which gives it a lovely flavour.
7. Now gradually add the roasted rava while stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
8. Cover and cook on low flame until the rava is completely cooked.
9. Serve hot with a teaspoon of ghee on top and some neer chutney!

snippet.description:
Aapki kidney har din karib 180 litre tarl chhanti hain, par peshab banta hai sirf 1-2 litre. Baaki tarl kahan chala jata hai? Is video mein GNM 1st year ka poora Urinary System aasaan tareeke se samjho, aur sabse aakhir mein is sawal ka jawab!

Chapters:
0:00 Hook: 180 litre aur 1-2 litre ki paheli
0:22 Urinary system ke 4 ang
0:34 Kidney: aakar, jagah (T12 se L3) aur right kidney neeche kyun
0:53 Kidney ke andar: cortex, medulla, renal pyramids, calyces, renal pelvis
1:09 Nephron: glomerulus se collecting duct tak (trick: G, P, L, D, C)
1:28 Ureter, bladder, urethra aur 2 sphincters
1:46 Nursing point: urethra ki lambai aur UTI
1:57 Paheli ka jawab
2:10 Recap aur agla video

Is video mein:
1. 4 ang: 2 kidneys, 2 ureters, urinary bladder, urethra
2. Kidney: sem ke aakar ki, mutthi jitni, T12 se L3 ke beech, right kidney liver ki wajah se thodi neeche. Dil ke 5 litre/min ka lagbhag chauthai hissa kidney se guzarta hai
3. Kidney ke andar: cortex, medulla (renal pyramids), minor calyces, major calyces, renal pelvis, phir ureter
4. Nephron (har kidney mein lagbhag 10 lakh): renal corpuscle (glomerulus + Bowman's capsule), proximal tubule, Loop of Henle, distal tubule, collecting duct
5. Ureter (25 se 30 cm, peristalsis), bladder (lagbhag 500 ml), urethra ke 2 sphincters (inner automatic, outer voluntary)
6. Female urethra lagbhag 4 cm, male lagbhag 20 cm, isliye mahilaon mein UTI ka khatra zyada
7. Jawab: chhane hue 180 litre mein se lagbhag 178 litre tubules mein wapas khoon mein sokh liya jata hai, aur bachta hai sirf 1-2 litre peshab

snippet.description:
Why microwaves don't escape through the window: the door is a metal sheet full of holes about 2 mm wide. The cooking waves are about 12 cm long and bounce back, while light waves are far thinner and pass straight through.
